comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. A new flange whose free end meets an existing flange across a bend (mitcad#1877, follow-up of mitcad#1872): t = 1, r = 1, K = 0.44, a 40 x 30 face (z = 0..1) and an inclined wall F4 of tangent length 20 turned 45 degrees up from its edge y = 30 At Edge (its bend's axis at y = 30, z = 2; its outer surface leaves the bend at (y, z) = (30 + sqrt2, 2 - sqrt2)). SheetFlange2 (F5): one plain Inside flange of tangent length 10 on the face's side x = 0: its wall x = 0..1, y = 0..30, z = 2..12; its 2 mm trim goes on through F4's bend, which keeps 38 of its 40 mm (0.375 pi per mm); the inclined wall keeps its 40 mm, its root free over x = 0..2. Before the new flange: face 38 x 30 + bend 38 (0.375 pi) + inclined wall 40 x 20 + F5's bend 30 (0.75 pi) and wall 300.
The corners the Flange panel maps a picked corner to (the sheet_flange_corners query, mitcad#1877): the inclined wall's side x = 0 and its far end meet at one corner, its far corner at x = 0.

The new flange F6, Inside, tangent length 10, Corner Gap 1, on the inclined wall's side x = 0 (its curve 50): its root end meets F5 across F4's bend, the two walls in the plane x = 0..1. It stops 1 mm short of F5's wall (y >= 31, F5's wall and bend reaching y = 30) and never cuts F5. On F6's wall (h its height over the inclined wall's outer surface, 2..12; s along the inclined wall's side, 0..20) y = 30 + sqrt2 + (s - h) / sqrt2, so the wall keeps s >= h - (2 - sqrt2): 10 x 20 less a triangle, 150 - 10 sqrt2 mm2; its bend starts where all of it clears y = 31, s >= sqrt2 (0.75 pi per mm over 20 - sqrt2); its 2 mm trim and corner cut take the inclined wall's strip x = 0..2 whole (38 x 20 left). Volume 2200 + 38 (0.375 pi) + 30 (0.75 pi) + (20 - sqrt2) 0.75 pi + 150 - 10 sqrt2.
The gap measured: F5's and F6's walls' outer faces (both in the plane x = 0) 1 mm apart; F5's wall uncut, 10 x 30.
Gap 0: walls in one plane would touch over their cut faces; refused in words.

expect.error_contains: lies in one plane with an existing flange's wall needs a Corner Gap above 0
